title: node:sqlite requires Node >=22.5 and is flagged experimental
evidence: src/db.ts:1 imports DatabaseSync from node:sqlite; README.md prerequisites say Node >=22.5. db.ts:9-20 monkey-patches process.emit to suppress the ExperimentalWarning.
suggestion: Acceptable for the embedded-DB requirement, but portability depends on the Node version; no change required.

title: Validation accepts numeric-string year but README implies integers only
evidence: src/validation.ts:44-48 accepts /^-?\d+$/ strings for year; normaliseYear (validation.ts:78) coerces them to number.
suggestion: Behaviour is lenient and tested; documented as 'numeric strings are accepted' in README. No change required.
